episodes.title: The First Record
episodes.summary: Do Min Joon, an alien who landed in Korea 400 years ago, discovers that he has three months left on Earth. And that is when he meets Cheon Song Yi, the biggest Hallyu star in Korea.

episodes.title: The Second Record
episodes.summary: Min Joon embarrasses Song Yi in public while she films for a documentary special about her daily life.

episodes.title: The Third Record
episodes.summary: Song Yi suffers from appendicitis, and forces Min Joon to take her to the hospital. He takes the opportunity to protect her from his premonition.

episodes.title: The Fourth Record
episodes.summary: When an actress dies from an accident, Song Yi is immediately the target for blame. She seeks refuge in Min Joon's apartment, uncovering secrets that he'd like to keep buried.

episodes.title: The Fifth Record
episodes.summary: Song Yi hides away in Min Joon's apartment after the suspicious death of fellow actress Han Yoo Ra. Prosecutor Yoo Suk begins an investigation to look into whether her death was a suicide or not.

episodes.title: The Sixth Record
episodes.summary: Following the Han Yoo Ra scandal, Song Yi postpones renewing her contract with her management.

episodes.title: The Seventh Record
episodes.summary: As the threats intensify, Song Yi turns to Min Joon for help. He slowly becomes more human-like by being around her so often, and agrees to be her temporary manager.

episodes.title: The Eighth Record
episodes.summary: Song Yi thinks stress is contributing to her "hallucinations" of Min Joon saving her. The investigation intensifies as witnesses to Jae Kyung and Yoo Ra's relationship begin to disappear.

episodes.title: The Ninth Record
episodes.summary: Min Joon gets sick after he shares a kiss with Song Yi. Se Mi decides to finally meet Min Joon for herself.

episodes.title: The Tenth Record
episodes.summary: Song Yi has difficulty dealing with her feelings for Min Joon, who's also trying to distance himself from her and not reveal his true nature to anyone.

episodes.title: The Eleventh Record
episodes.summary: Jae Kyung will go at any lengths to get Song Yi and Min Joon. Jae Kyung begins to view his brother in a different light.

episodes.title: The Twelfth Record
episodes.summary: Song Yi refuses to hear what Se Mi has to say about her savior from 12 years ago. Min Joon recovers from his injuries but realizes that his heart is now broken.

episodes.title: The Thirteenth Record
episodes.summary: Min Joon does his best to distance himself from Song Yi and hold up his end of the deal with Jae Kyung.

episodes.title: The Fourteenth Record
episodes.summary: When Song Yi's wires break while shooting, it's a game to the death with no holds barred between Min Joon and Jae Kyung.

episodes.title: The Fifteenth Record
episodes.summary: Song Yi recovers from her injuries but Hee Kyung is still in a coma. Min Joon can't stay away from protecting Song Yi.

episodes.title: The Sixteenth Record
episodes.summary: Min Joon and Song Yi admit their feelings for one another and start dating, but his departure date looms near.

episodes.title: The Seventeenth Record
episodes.summary: Hee Kyung won't stop until he finds his sister-in-law and uncovers his brother's dark secrets. Song Yi and Min Joon can't deal with the fact that he'll need to leave in a month.

episodes.title: The Eighteenth Record
episodes.summary: Min Joon's powers weaken as he stays on Earth longer than he should. Hee Kyung discovers his brother's true self but it will be more difficult than it seems to have him pay for his crimes.

episodes.title: The Nineteenth Record
episodes.summary: Hee Kyung must find a way to stop Jae Kyung before he himself ends up on his brother's hit list. Song Yi discovers the price Min Joon must pay if he stays with her.

episodes.title: The Twentieth Record
episodes.summary: With one week left before he leaves, Song Yi and Min Joon spend each day as if they had seventy more years left together.

episodes.title: Last Record
episodes.summary: Do Min Joon's departure is too difficult to bear for Song Yi, even three years later.
